basic_info.description: Charming 2BD/1BA Traditional tunnel-entrance home with bonus room and bath down, nestled on a deep lot in the desirable Parkside neighborhood, just steps from Sunset Reservoir, Noriega Street shops, and local schools. This attractive 1940's split-level greets visitors w/a bright FLR w/large windows for lots of natural light and peek-a-boo views of the Pacific Ocean and Marin Headlands. Nearby is a modern kitchen that boasts rich wood cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and a cozy b-fast nook that provides an ideal spot for meals or morning coffee. Two generously-sized BDs, both w/good closet space, and one w/French doors to its own private rear deck, and an updated BA w/shower over tub, complete the home's main living level. Downstairs is a bonus room w/doors to the rear patio, and a full BA, all of which could make for an excellent primary suite or home office. Fresh paint, refinished floors, and lots of recent thoughtful updates run throughout. Out back, the property's 100 Ft deep lot affords a large rear yard ready for gardening, pets and play, that includes new fencing, rear siding, and a large storage shed. Excellent Parkside location near local parks, schools,  shopping and dining, and easy access to major city thoroughfares and public transit.
